decision_needed: Validate comparator relevance for the nine cases?
what_the_files_show: RI-FMW-015: Montenegro High (same issue and capacity mechanism; card deferred to accession, feasibility study, action plan, health information system to adapt), Croatia Medium (completed EHIC preparation before accession, but already had the national card and CEZIH, so it shows the end state, not how to build the preconditions), Serbia Low (matches only the Commission's request; nothing on its own card or system). RI-TEC-038: Montenegro Medium (a recent system found technically limited and upgraded with EU funds, not a replacement), North Macedonia Low (a working system updated in 2025; no item shows an outdated system replaced). RI-TEC-036: North Macedonia High (same mechanism, the only quantified rise in portal use from a low level), Albania and Montenegro Medium (reused validated cases). An independent check found 6 serious and 32 minor problems, all corrected; three values lowered or changed (Serbia relevance to Low, one attribution, one success).
agent_recommendation: Validate all nine. Note that RI-TEC-038 has no case of an outdated system actually replaced; its lessons are about diagnosis before building, not replacement.
what_changes: Only validated cases may feed draft policy options for Moldova.

decision_needed: Validate transferability for the nine cases?
what_the_files_show: All labelled agent synthesis. Conditional for eight: Croatia (only after Moldova builds the national card and integrated system), Montenegro EHIC (needs a system to adapt and EU acceptance of deferral to accession), Montenegro e-procurement (an independent technical diagnostic before the new system is built), North Macedonia e-procurement (needs a working new core system first), North Macedonia portal (most-requested citizen services first; promotion and a price advantage for electronic documents), Albania (consolidation alone does not raise use among rural and older users; maintenance needs its own budget), Montenegro portal (a delivered count does not show working, used services). Serbia insufficient_evidence (no mechanism shown to transfer).
what_changes: Validated lessons can be used in Moldova's draft options at stage 12.
